mentions.claim_text: Asked by his co-host what he had been praying over, he says he has been praying over a named Balkan country that day and that the Lord gave him something about it.
mentions.quote: I've been praying over Kosovo today
mentions.falsify_match: The named place becomes significant in the way he later attaches to it.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Nothing is claimed here beyond that he prayed over it.
